messages:
mia: Heads-up: we’re doing the EU midnight rolling freeze + canary tomorrow 00:00 CET. Quick preflight here, please call out any blockers.

sam: I’ll run the deploy-bot dry-run at 23:30 CET and post results. can we pin the model to v3.2.1 for the first wave?

jordan: +1 on pin. Also need autoscaler bump for canary: min=2 max=6 for the first 20m.

alex: Obs smoke checks I want: 95th latency < 180ms, error rate < 0.5% (5m rollup), token cost within baseline. If any fail, we stop and rollback.

release-coordinator: Noted. Added to checklist. Also: confirm release notes published and changelog link in the deploy ticket.

mia: Checklist I'm tracking: 1) pin to v3.2.1, 2) deploy-bot dry-run, 3) autoscaler config, 4) smoke checks & dashboards green, 5) fallback model v3.1.8 available, 6) support oncall.

deploy-bot: dry-run initiated by @sam at 2026-03-19T23:30:00Z
```
Dry-run steps:
 - create canary group (10%)
 - route 200rps for 10m
 - run smoke tests: latency, errors, mem
```

deploy-bot: dry-run result: SUCCESS. canary created, 10% routing simulated. metrics sampled.

sam: raw metrics: requests=120k, error_rate=0.12%, p95=142ms, cpu=62%, gpu_mem=71%. Logs attached to ticket. :thumbsup:

jordan: Looks healthy. Confirm autoscaler config applied.

deploy-bot: autoscaler update applied: min=2 max=6 target_cpu=60%

alex: Observability: Grafana snapshots show p95=148ms under synthetic load, errors 0.11%. I ran trace on a sample slow request, root cause was cold-kv fetch at t=3.5s but p95 unaffected.

sre-oncall: I’ll be on standby 23:45-01:00 CET and monitoring infra alerts. If latency > 220ms sustained for 2m or error_rate > 1% immediate rollback.

release-coordinator: Rollback decision tree in brief: 1) Canary fails smoke -> pin back to v3.1.8 + stop rollout. 2) Production regression after >2% user impact -> emergency freeze + rollback. 3) Infra saturation -> scale down rollout and engage infra runbook.

mia: Two quick exceptions: third-party embedding service outage exemption if degradations are <0.3% and we have a mitigation path. Otherwise we abort.

sam: I’ll trigger a dry-run again at 23:55 to validate final pin and autoscaler. will report final go/no-go here by 23:58 CET.

alex: Added a synthetic traffic job to run at 00:00 CET for 10m against canary routes.

jordan: Added a short AB test plan: 50/50 traffic split after 30m if canary stable for 15m. metrics to watch: latency, errors, embeddings deviation.

mia: Thanks all. Final items: support email in ticket, release notes link, and escrowed rollback commit hash. Post canary OK then we proceed with staged roll for EU region. :rocket:

release-coordinator: Published release notes: https://internal/release/2411. Rollback commit: `git@repo:deploy#c9f4a1b`.

sam: final status: dry-run ✅, pin v3.2.1 applied, autoscaler live. go/no-go: GO from me.

sre-oncall: Monitoring ready. Ready from my side.

mia: GO from product. Starting quiet window at 23:59 CET. Remember quiet-channel only for urgent rollbacks.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started at 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z, group=EU-midnight-canary, pct=10%.

alex: Running first 5m checks now. Will call timeout if any metric breaches.

(END)
